Theorem
[Existence of Dirichlet heat kernel] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0313 ↗ lem:chow-iii-evolving-dirichlet-problem ↗ thm:chow-iii-closed-evolving-heat-kernel 1. ch24:24.32\group Dirichlet Heat Kernels

Let $\widetilde H$ be the heat kernel on a closed extension of $\mathcal M$, and let $f_{y,v}$ solve the homogeneous equation with zero initial data and boundary value $-\widetilde H(\cdot ,\cdot ;y,v)$. Then \[ H(x,\tau ;y,v)=\widetilde H(x,\tau ;y,v)+f_{y,v}(x,\tau ) \] is the fundamental solution satisfying the Dirichlet boundary condition.
